testcase.name: Should fall back to ClientErrorException for non-JSON error response
Should use default message when message field is missing
Should throw PaymentException for payment error type
Should throw ServerErrorException for 5xx errors without JSON
Should throw APIException for ubb_batch_ingestion_invalid_request type (unrecognized type)
Should not throw exception for successful response
Should throw generic APIException for unknown error type
Should handle unknown api_error_code with _UNKNOWN enum
Should throw InvalidRequestException for invalid_request error type
Should handle empty error response gracefully
Should throw OperationFailedException for operation_failed error type
Should throw APIException for batch URL (batch handling not yet implemented)
Should fall back to ClientErrorException when only message field is present
Should throw generic APIException when type is missing but message and api_error_code exist
